liveActivity.foregroundWarning: For the most accurate distance, keep this page open and your screen active. Mobile browsers may pause GPS when the phone is locked or the browser is in the background.
liveActivity.discardMessage: The tracked time and location samples will be permanently removed.
liveActivity.storageError: The activity could not be stored on this device. Free some browser storage and try again.
liveActivity.storageWarning: Location storage is temporarily unavailable. Time tracking continues, but new distance samples may be lost.

rejection.accuracy: A GPS sample was ignored because its accuracy was too low.
rejection.movement: GPS is responding; movement is below the distance threshold.
rejection.timestamp: An older GPS sample was ignored.
rejection.speed: An implausibly fast GPS sample was ignored.
rejection.coordinates: An invalid GPS sample was ignored.

location.weak-signal: GPS signal is currently too weak for an accurate distance
location.recovering: GPS was interrupted and is reconnecting automatically…
location.stale: No recent GPS update was received; tracking is restarting…
location.background-limited: GPS was interrupted while the app was in the background
location.denied: Location permission was denied; time tracking continues
location.unavailable: Location tracking is unavailable; time tracking continues
location.error: GPS did not respond correctly; time tracking continues
